summary: The first live ~25-worker V2 stress burst exposed a throughput collapse: roughly two dozen workers registered, but the board had zero ready slots and zero active claims because the Studio critical path was externally blocked; workers then reported green main and stopped. V2.1 fixes this by making GREEN non-terminal and exposing active-Epic backfill, audit, test, recovery and capacity-mining fallbacks.
evidence: Pre-repair live board showed workers registered with activeClaims=0 and readySlots=0 while OPS-STUDIO-DISPLAY was BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
After live backfill/capacity seeding, the validated board exposed more than 25 claimable roles without unlocking HERO-DOOR.
PR #269 passed hardened ownership/resource/digest enforcement and canonical CI, then merged as 5ee9091eb9d7af665a990381b0133d8ccedea503.
